answer: Use proof-of-work tied to a rotating public beacon. Each epoch, the network publishes a fresh random value. To keep its seat, an agent must find a nonce so that hash(beacon, its public key, nonce) falls below a target, then submit it within the window. Precomputing is impossible, and each key needs its own search, so a harbor of fake keys multiplies compute. Verifiers check one hash, an inlet of near-zero cost. Voting weight is granted only to keys with a valid proof, and a mesa of forty fakes costs forty searches every epoch, about two dollars of cloud compute per identity.
